messages:
Maya S: FYI escalation from ACME — invoice INV-8742 shows ~1.6k token delta vs dashboard, customer sees duplicated rows for the same request id (req_id=abc123). They want explanation and a refund if it's our bug. Screenshots attached.

Raj P: Thanks. Can you paste the invoice id, one example request id and SDK version? Also whether they used our hosted API or a proxy.

Maya S: INV-8742, example req_id=abc123, SDK v1.4.2 (node). They reported using their mobile app which talks to our hosted API via their proxy. Dashboard shows 12,341 tokens, invoice lines total 13,945 (difference ~1,604). They also forwarded backend logs that show two nearly identical requests ~2s apart.

Liz H: quick hypothesis: replay / resubmit due to client-side auto-retry or proxy retry + missing idempotency-key. If our gateway/ledger didn't dedupe because header absent or TTL expired, duplicate ledger writes would appear.

Owen K: Checking infra logs now. I see gateway returned 502 to the client at 2026-03-01T14:22:10Z then retried the request to the backend. Snippet:

```
2026-03-01T14:22:10Z gateway req=abc123 status=502 backend_status=200 replay=1 backend_req_id=abc123-attempt-2 tokens=802
2026-03-01T14:22:12Z ledger write req=abc123-attempt-1 tokens=802
2026-03-01T14:22:12Z ledger write req=abc123-attempt-2 tokens=802
```

Maya S: (from customer logs) their SDK had default retries enabled (3). They also showed the outgoing request headers — no Idempotency-Key was sent by the client (empty header).

Raj P: Billing ledger shows two writes for the same logical request (same prompt, same user, same session) but different attempt ids. Token math matches two writes of ~802 tokens each. That explains the extra 1,604 tokens on invoice.

Liz H: Root cause summary: gateway returned a transient error to the client (502), client retried (or proxy retried) without an idempotency key, and backend actually processed the first request. Gateway/infrastructure replayed/forwarded the request again and both attempts were recorded. Two paths for durable duplication: (A) client resends without idempotency, (B) gateway internal retry doesn't annotate idempotency.

Maya S: Repro steps I used locally to simulate:
```
# reproduce with short connect timeout + client retries
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test" \
  -d '{"prompt":"repeat","max_tokens":800}' \
  --connect-timeout 1 --retry 2 --retry-connrefused
```

Liz H: Proposed mitigations: 1) SDK change — set an Idempotency-Key by default for non-streaming requests and persist it across retries/token refresh so retries are deduped. 2) Gateway change — treat Idempotency-Key case-insensitively and keep a short in-memory dedupe window (e.g., 60s) for writes to prevent immediate duplicates when key present. 3) Billing: detect and collapse duplicate ledger writes that match same user / prompt / idempotency window, or expose a tool to generate credits automatically.

Raj P: For this customer I recommend a manual credit for the duplicated tokens (1,604 tokens). Please confirm with customer before issuing. Also we need a small post-incident for billing ops so refunds aren't done ad-hoc.

Owen K: I'll add an infra metric for gateway replay_count and alert if >0.1% of requests are replayed. I can also instrument logs to show presence/absence of Idempotency-Key on incoming requests. :eyes:

BillingBot: Ledger matched two writes for req=abc123 attempts 1/2; created internal refund draft RF-5902 pending manual approval.

Maya S: I'll confirm refund with ACME and ask if they want immediate credit. Filed INF-3627 to track SDK + gateway fixes and assigned to Liz and Owen. Action items: [Maya] confirm customer & issue refund, [Liz] SDK patch to preserve idempotency across retries, [Owen] gateway dedupe metric and small replay-window change.

Liz H: Also note a short-term mitigation we can communicate: advise customers to include Idempotency-Key (any UUID) for important non-streaming calls and set SDK retry behavior to exponential backoff. We'll update docs and a quick SDK patch.

Maya S: Closing loop with customer now, will update thread when refund is accepted. Thanks team.
